title: OnePlus is sold out in the US and Canada - there are no more phones on the official site
description: Good night, sweet prince – OnePlus is officially out of the US market. On July 16, the company made the initial announcement that it will be exiting the North American and European markets. And now the last OnePlus phone has been sold via oneplus.com. The OnePlus 15 and OnePlus 15R are both out of stock on the official site. The site is now pretty barren – there are no more tablets, no smartwatches either. You can still find some headphones and a few other accessories, but that’s about it. The OnePlus Canada site has even less – there, even the OnePlus Buds are out of stock. There are no...

title: Apple to add cross-device clipboard syncing between iPhone and Windows in the EU
description: Windows PC users in the EU could soon be able to copy and paste content directly to and from an iPhone, thanks to a new interoperability feature Apple is developing. The feature was requested by Microsoft through Apple's EU Interoperability Request system. Apple began working on the request in March this year and submitted a proposed implementation plan in June. Microsoft's Phone Link on iOS (Credit - Microsoft) The feature would let users copy text and other supported content on an iPhone and paste it onto a Windows PC, with the reverse also supported. Clipboard syncing would work...

title: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL stars in some new leaked renders
description: Google is officially unveiling the Pixel 11 family on August 12, and ahead of that we've already seen the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold in leaked marketing materials courtesy of Evan Blass aka @evleaks. Now, he's back with the only missing piece of the puzzle: the Pixel 11 Pro XL. Google Pixel 11 Pro XL leaked renders As you'd expect, this is just a larger version of the Pixel 11 Pro, carrying the exact same design as that device. There's the new Pixel 11 family trait, which is the camera bar that's now fully glass-covered, as well as the Pixel 11 Pro series’...

title: Motorola teases the launch of the Edge 70 neo in the most unusual way
description: Motorola has the Edge 70, the Edge 70 Max, the Edge 70 Pro and Pro+, the Edge 70 Fusion and Fusion+, and the Ultra, but there's no Neo, at least thus far. Тhat is about to change according to a forum post about the Android 17 Beta for the Motorola Edge 70 Neo by a senior forum member, the phone is likely coming soon. The post reads as a call for participants for a firmware beta test about an existing phone, which points to one of two scenarios - either the person leaked an unannounced phone, or he made a mistake and meant another model. It's unlikely to be a mistake, however, as the...

title: iPhone 20 series rumored to get improved cooling, Air-inspired frame
description: Apple's 20th anniversary iPhone models, expected to be called the iPhone 20, are rumored to debut in fall 2027 with a major redesign. The phones are said to feature curved glass on both the front and back, along with solid-state buttons. Now, a new leak has offered more details on its internal design and cooling system. According to tipster Fixed Focus Digital, the iPhone 20 series will feature a frame similar to the one used on the iPhone Air and also closely match the slim profile of Apple's ultra-thin handset. iPhone Air The tipster also claims that the iPhone 20 will offer...

title: Samsung offers no cost EMI for the Galaxy Z Fold8, Z Fold8 Ultra, and Z Flip8 in India
description: Samsung has introduced No Cost EMI financing for buyers of its latest foldables in India. Eligible customers can spread the cost over up to 18 months without paying interest or making a down payment, as Samsung covers the financing charges. The Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra starts at INR 11,111 per month for 18 months (INR 199,999 for the 12/256GB model). It's available in Violet Shadow, Graphite, Cream, and the online-exclusive Green Shadow, with 12/512GB and 16GB/1TB versions also on offer. The Galaxy Z Fold8 starts at INR 9,999.94 per month (INR 179,999 for the 12/256GB model) and comes in...

title: Microsoft is working on emulators to run old Xbox games on PCs and the upcoming Xbox Helix
description: Xbox is struggling – in its latest quarterly report, Microsoft reported that Xbox hardware sales were down 13% and that Xbox content and services revenue was down 10% compared to the same period last year. The recent price hikes aren’t helping the situation either. However, the tech giant may have a plan to leverage the storied Xbox name – backwards compatibility. In a leaked memo seen by The Verge, Microsoft tells game publishers that it is working on official emulators that will support every console generation: the 2001 original, the Xbox 360, the Xbox One and the latest Xbox Series...

title: Oppo A7 Pro Max is official with Oppo's biggest battery ever
description: As expected, Oppo has fully unveiled the A7 Pro Max today. This mid-range smartphone's very obvious claim to fame is that it sports Oppo's biggest battery yet, with a capacity of 10,000 mAh. It charges at 80W and supports 27W reverse wired charging. Oppo says it can last for at least 1,500 charge cycles before the capacity drops below 80%. The phone has a 6.78-inch 1272x2772 AMOLED screen with a 120Hz refresh rate, a 1,800-nit peak brightness, and an embedded optical fingerprint scanner, a 50MP f/1,8 main camera, a 2MP monochrome camera, and a 50MP f/2.0 selfie camera with...

title: Indian handset maker Lava to make its UK debut soon with the Agni 4N
description: Indian handset maker Lava was expected to enter the UK smartphone market in Q1 2026. That didn't happen, but we now know Lava will make its UK debut soon, as it has teased a new smartphone for the UK market. The smartphone in question is the Lava Agni 4N, which hasn't been launched yet in India either. The brand hasn't divulged any specs or features of the Agni 4N; however, the teaser it posted on X suggests its camera island on the rear will look identical to the Agni 4's, which was introduced in India last November. The teaser image also says that the Agni 4N "does what SAM can't."...

title: Poco M8 Power arrives with a 120Hz screen, Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 SoC, and an 8,000 mAh battery
description: As promised, Poco today unveiled the Poco M8 Power, making it the fourth smartphone in Poco's M8 series. One of the headline features of the Poco M8 Power is its 8,000 mAh battery, advertised to offer up to 28 hours of video playback, 14 hours of gaming, 31 hours of social media use, 11 hours of navigation, or 38 days of standby. The smartphone supports 45W wired and 22.5W reverse wired charging. Poco M8 Power packs an 8,000 mAh battery The Poco M8 Power is built around a 6.9" 120Hz FullHD+ AMOLED display with Gorilla Glass 7i protection and a fingerprint scanner underneath...

title: The new Galaxy Z8 foldables finally beat Galaxy Note10's long-standing pre-order record
description: Many years ago, the Galaxy Note10 and Note10+ set a long-standing pre-order record in South Korea of 1.38 million units. To be fair, this was over a fairly long 11-day pre-order period, but it was still a feat that later Galaxys failed to match. The new Galaxy Z8 trio has finally surpassed the old master – the new foldable flagships saw 1.44 million pre-orders total, reports Yonhap News. What’s even more impressive is that this was done over a short period – pre-orders ran from Wednesday to Monday. Let’s rewind the tape and see how past models performed to put this number into context....

title: Redmi K100 Pro to use a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V SoC, design and key specs revealed
description: After revealing the design and key features of the Redmi K100 Pro Max recently, the company has now started to reveal more details about the Redmi K100 Pro. In a series of posts on Weibo, Redmi has confirmed that the K100 Pro will be powered by a new Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V chipset, bearing the model number SM8850-1-AB. The company claims the handset scored 4.09 million points in the AnTuTu benchmark. It will also feature a dedicated graphics chip and a 3D circulating cold-pump cooling system. Redmi has also confirmed that the K100 Pro will sport a 6.59-inch AMOLED display...

title: Flipkart reveals the launch date of Boltt's first smartphone
description: Back in June, we heard that Fire-Boltt would expand into the smartphone business in India, but we didn't have the specifics. Well, thanks to Indian online retailer Flipkart, we now know when Fire-Boltt will launch its first smartphone. Fire-Boltt, which currently sells smartwatches, earphones, and smart glasses, will launch its first smartphone under the Boltt branding in India on August 25. The promo page set up by Flipkart on its website doesn't reveal the name of the smartphone Boltt will unveil on August 25, but it states that Boltt smartphones will come with "Honest...

title: Google teases Pixel 11 Pro Fold in new official video
description: Google has released the first official teaser for the Pixel 11 Pro Fold, which is set to debut on August 12. While the video doesn't reveal much about the foldable, previous leaks have already detailed its design and key specs. The teaser video offers a brief look at the Pixel 11 Pro Fold's silhouette, along with a glimpse of its inner display. We can also see the rear camera module, which appears to retain the same design as the one found on the Pixel 10 Pro Fold. Previously leaked renders suggest the upcoming foldable will closely resemble its predecessor in terms of design and...

title: Honor Robot Phone specs leak
description: Honor's long-awaited Robot Phone is finally going to be fully unveiled on August 12, and the company has already confirmed details about its cameras in late July. Today a new leak from Digital Chat Station on Weibo reveals the device's full specs, and the brand itself has published the teaser images you can see below. The Robot Phone will allegedly have a 6.3-inch flat LTPO OLED screen with 1216x2640 resolution, a whopping 6,800-nit peak brightness, and an anti-reflective coating. title: TCL Tab A1 Plus Nxtpaper is now available in the US
description: TCL unveiled the Tab A1 Plus and its Nxtpaper variant in early March at MWC, and now the Nxtpaper version is finally available in the US. You can grab it from TCL's online store for $299.99 for a limited time during the company’s Back to School sale, or from Amazon. The RRP is $399.99. The tablet comes with a 12.2-inch 2400x1600 LCD screen with a 120Hz refresh rate, 3:2 aspect ratio, and 500-nit peak brightness, TCL's Nxtpaper tech with its matte display look, the Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC, 6GB of RAM, 256GB of expandable storage, an 8MP front camera, an 8MP main camera, and a 10,000 mAh...

title: Sony adds an interesting new color to its WH-1000XM6 range
description: Sony's successful flagship noise-cancelling headphones, the WH-1000XM6, are now available in a new color: Olive Gray. That's right, Olive Gray, not Olive Green as you might have expected. As you can see it has a very subtle shade of green - it's almost gray, but not quite. This is the sixth color option for the WH-1000XM6, joining black, Platinum Silver, Midnight Blue, Sand Pink, and Sandstone in the lineup. Obviously, the new color doesn't change the specs in any way, so you're getting the same top-tier noise cancellation enabled by the QN3 processor, up to 30 hours of battery life...

title: Google Pixel 11 Pro marketing materials leak confirming some specs
description: After showing us marketing materials for the Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro Fold last week, Evan Blass aka @evleaks is back today with the Pixel 11 Pro. As you can see, the design is similar to that of the Pixel 11, but the Pro has the Pixel Glow round RGB LED light on the back, which will be used for notifications and such. Google Pixel 11 Pro leaked images Like the rest of the family, the Pixel 11 Pro's camera bump is now fully glass-clad, there's no more metal bit on the right side. title: Google rolls out Android 17 QPR 1 Beta 8 to Pixel devices
description: Google is rolling out the Android 17 QPR 1 Beta 8. This update will be available to AOSP, as well as to Google Pixel devices, as part of Feature Drops. This update does not feature new user-facing changes, and is focused on critical bug fixes and system performance. One of the changes in this update is a fix for the loud audio distortion and static. The update addresses a persistent buffer management flaw within the audio framework, which resulted in random bursts of loud static and corrupted audio during media playback and system notifications. title: Google kills unreleased AI app
description: Google is rather notorious for killing apps and services left and right, even quite successful ones. This time, however, the company has gone further than it usually does and killed an app that was never released to begin with. It was called Google AI Studio and it was supposed to become available on both Android and iOS. The app was listed in the Google Play Store and the App Store as a pre-order, and about 800,000 people actually pre-ordered it, so clearly there was some interest for it out there.
